title: Inverse transpose of the ordered integration map
statement: Fix a finite purity setting P [def-pur-affine-ordered-integration-data], a scheme Y and a separated finite-type structure map aY:Y→Spec(k). Let K be a bounded-below pro-etale coefficient complex with ordinary constructible finite-Tor representative Ke and realization eK. Use the standing compact-support functor F_p and exceptional counit epsilon_p of [lem-pur-affine-line-composite-transpose]. For every d≥0, put p=iteratedAffineLineProj Y (d+1), T=integrationTranspose at stage d+1, s=(sourceComparison at stage d+1).hom and a=augmentation at stage d+1, all exactly as in [def-pur-affine-ordered-integration-data]. Then F_p(T);epsilon_p,K = F_p(s);a. The restricted exceptional Hom bijection is applied only to the bounded-below etale-origin source specified by source_origin.

proof.text: Identify the chosen integration map by its unique-HEq specification, use map_comp, and cancel the standing transpose using the inverse law of the restricted exceptional Hom bijection.

lean.statement:
theorem integrationTranspose_counit
    (P : WeilConjectures.PurityFiniteSetting.{u})
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) (aY : Y ⟶ Spec (.of P.field.k))
    [LocallyOfFiniteType aY] [QuasiCompact aY] [IsSeparated aY]
    (K : Plus (AffineLinePurity.Ring P) Y)
    (Ke : Etale.DerivedCategoryModule (AffineLinePurity.Ring P) Y)
    (hKe : etaleFiniteTor (AffineLinePurity.Ring P) Y Ke)
    (eK : (comparison (AffineLinePurity.Ring P) Y).obj Ke ≅ K.obj) (d : ℕ) :
    (AffineLineEvaluation.support P aY (iteratedAffineLineProj Y (d + 1))).map
        (integrationTranspose P Y aY K Ke hKe eK (d + 1)) ≫
      AffineLineEvaluation.counit P aY (iteratedAffineLineProj Y (d + 1)) K =
    (AffineLineEvaluation.support P aY (iteratedAffineLineProj Y (d + 1))).map
        (sourceComparison P Y K.obj (d + 1)).hom ≫
      augmentation P Y aY K Ke hKe eK (d + 1)
